project.name: Arturia KeyLab Essential 61 mk3 Study and Setup Plan
project.objective: Create a reproducible operating setup for the Arturia KeyLab Essential 61 mk3.

goals: Establish and document reliable USB MIDI on Linux.
Create a direct five-pin MIDI route to the Roland XPS-30.
Keep DAW-control and performance MIDI ports distinct.
Preserve firmware and MIDI Control Center mappings before changes.
